text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While doing the rounds after school, I
notice two
students chatting in a corner
of the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't tell anyone l was coming, just
like you
asked. What's this important
thing you have to
tell me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Are you familiar with the batting
cages in
front of the station?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. I go to those cages all
the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then are you also aware that the prize
for
becoming the home run king this
month is a ball
signed by Yutaka?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's talking about it. All
the regulars
are gunning for that prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then I have a request for you. I'd like
you to
teach me some strength training
techniques that'll
help me to hit home
runs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... You don't need any
strength
training, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What exactly do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, I'm currently the home
run king!
And I was gonna give you the
ball when the
rankings are finalized!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...My deepest apologies, but I'm afraid I
cannot
accept the signed ball from you,
as kind an offer
as that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait... Why not, McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That ball is meant to reward one's
efforts. To
accept such a reward without
having made any
effort would be
inexcusable. An Umamusume of
the
Mejiro family could never.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The victory, the glory, the signed ball...
It is one's
own efforts that imbue these
things with value!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You're right. You're totally right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We should battle each other to the best
of our
abilities, and leave with no
regrets... Now then, if
you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Continuing my rounds, I spot Mejiro
McQueen
again at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Right then, how shall I begin? Perhaps
with some
dumbbell exercises?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If it's dumbbells you're thinking of, some

single-arm rows would be good. They're
great for
your lats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... Why are you giving me advice?
Do you
not wish to defend your position
as the home run
king?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I don't plan on giving up my home
run
crown. I'm here to train, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just want to take you on after you've
trained
your glutes off! That's why I'm
gonna give you all
the support I can!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay McQueen, let's hit the weights
hard, get
ripped, and battle it out to see
who's the true
home run king!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Oh, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can think of nothing I'd enjoy more! I
shall make
you regret training me so
well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We're starting with five sets of thirty
single-arm
rows!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two Mejiros work up a huge sweat
pumping
iron until the curfew forces
them to return to their
dorms.
